headline: xAI reports large short-phrase accuracy gain in Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 launch
summary: xAI announced Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 on 18 Sep 2026, claiming improved transcription across four internal sets, unchanged pricing and first place for accuracy among 32 streaming models on Artificial Analysis. On an internal short-phrase set, xAI reports word error rate falling from 20.6% to 6.8% versus version 1.0. The internal sets are not public, the external leaderboard’s model-specific plotted values were not extractable from its page text in this review, and no exact latency tradeoff was verified.
